payload.name: Symbol Superiority Effect
payload.fact: Graphic symbols are better remembered than words, similar to the picture superiority effect.
payload.boundary: This effect applies to common graphic symbols and is attributed to dual coding and distinctiveness.

provenance.title: Symbol superiority: Why $ is better remembered than ‘dollar’
provenance.quote_or_locus: This study is the first to present evidence that, like pictures, graphic symbols are better remembered than words
